# Twemoji

These images in `composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/drawable/` come from Twemoji:

- `flag_xx.svg`: country flags
- `icon_chicken.svg`, `icon_trophy.svg`: chicken and trophy
- `icon_status_*.svg`: status icons (empty ⚪, in progress ⏳, manual ☑️, completed ✅)

- Source: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji (tag `v15.1.0`)
- Copyright 2020 Twitter, Inc and other contributors
- License: CC-BY 4.0 (see `LICENSE-GRAPHICS`)
- The files are used without changes.
- Run `scripts/download-country-flags.sh` to download them again.
